entities.summary: Margaret Ann "Maggie" Estep was an American writer and poet, best known for coming to prominence during the height of the spoken word and poetry slam performance rage. She published seven books and released two spoken word albums: No More Mr. Nice Girl and Love is a Dog. Maggie Estep was a authors & novelists from Summit (1963-03-20, Summit–2014-02-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
